name: Life After Henshin
source:
It's been two months since the defeat of Emperor Calamus, the Scourge of the Universe at the hands of six teens known as the Force Wardens, secret protectors of Earth from Calamus and the threats he would unleash upon the world. But since his defeat, there's been no need for the Force Wardens to remain active. Now back to being ordinary people, they must contend with no longer being able to transform and fight for justice in their own unique ways.

Life After Henshin is a visual novel inspired by Power Rangers and Super Sentai, exploring what happens after the series finale for the main characters. From restless longing for the "glory days" to dealing with the lingering effects from battling with aliens, the game aims to explore themes traditionally not explored in the early days of the genre.

[from [url=https://distracted-devs.itch.io/life-after-henshin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个月前，人称“宇宙之灾”的卡拉穆斯皇帝，被六位名为“力量守卫”的少年击败。他们一直秘密守护地球，对抗卡拉穆斯及其带来的威胁。然而，随着他败亡，力量守卫也不再有继续行动的必要。如今重新成为普通人的他们，必须面对再也无法变身、以各自独特的方式为正义而战的生活。

《Life After Henshin》是一部受到《恐龙战队》与《超级战队》启发的视觉小说，探讨大结局之后，主人公们会迎来怎样的人生。从对“光辉岁月”的躁动怀念，到面对与外星人战斗留下的长期影响，游戏希望探索这类作品早期通常未曾涉及的主题。

[摘自[url=https://distracted-devs.itch.io/life-after-henshin]itch.io[/url]]
